messages:
Omar (AE): Heads-up — Pegasus onramp call tomorrow 10am PT. They want: reserved GPU recommendation for initial P0, preheat window, and a short KMS/HSM note for their security form.
Elaine (SRE): Do we have expected qps and avg tokens/request?
Omar (AE): Sales profile: peak 600 qps, avg 120 tokens/request, 95% chat SLO = 250ms. Bursty — ~30% daytime spikes.
Sasha (ML Eng): Calc: 120 toks/request @600 qps => ~72k toks/s. Rule of thumb: 1 reserved GPU ≈ 150 qps at this seq with quantized model. Baseline 4 GPUs to hit 600 qps sustained.
Matt (Solutions): Add headroom for autoscale failover & KV warmup. Recommend 5 reserved baseline, autoscale up to 8 for bursts. Preheat/kv warmup 12–30 min depending on payload.
Keith (Prod Eng): If they insist on <250ms p95, prefer higher baseline or low-latency model variant. Autoscale cold starts to quantized variants add ~200–400ms.
Omar (AE): Pegasus wants a one-line delta on MRR for 5 vs 4 reserved GPUs. Procurement needs a number.
Matt (Solutions): 1 reserved GPU = $Xk/mo per pricing sheet. Delta 4→5 = +$Xk/mo. I'll DM exact.
Elaine (SRE): Security Q: KMS/HSM — we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private; hosted offers envelope encryption and optional customer key integration (BYK). HSM-backed key storage via enterprise contract. Ref: https://redwood.example.com/kms
Omar (AE): Do preheat/KV warmups need customer networking changes (VPC peering)?
Keith (Prod Eng): For Dedicated we can prewarm without changes. For Private/VPC, initial peering and a short maintenance window may be required to pull caches (~12–30min) and a small network egress burst.
Sasha (ML Eng): KV warmup plan: we seed top-n prefixes using historical prompts. If customer provides 5–10k representative prompts we can reach ~80–90% cache hit post-preheat; otherwise add ~20% reserved headroom.
Omar (AE): Draft a 2-line procurement blurb (commit/burst + security).
Matt (Solutions): Draft: "Recommended baseline: 5 reserved GPUs to support 600 qps with 120 tokens/request aiming for ~250ms p95; autoscale policy to 8 GPUs for spikes. Preheat/KV warmup 12–30 minutes; supplying 5–10k representative prompts improves cache hit rates. Pricing delta per GPU: +$Xk/mo (Matt to confirm)."
Elaine (SRE): Security blurb: "Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private and envelope encryption for hosted; HSM-backed keys and audit logs are available under enterprise terms."
Omar (AE): Lower-cost option?
Sasha (ML Eng): Quantized model variant reduces cost ~20–30% with modest quality delta; expect p95 to increase ~50–120ms depending on length. Good for non-interactive/high-throughput workloads.
Omar (AE): One-liner about quality tradeoffs?
Sasha (ML Eng): "Quantized variant: ~25% lower per-token cost; minor quality delta that depends on eval set; recommended for high-throughput, latency-tolerant inference."
Omar (AE): infra-bot, can you simulate 600 qps/120 tokens with 5 reserved and autoscale to 8 and post expected p95?
infra-bot: Simulation queued (job 87321). Results in ~15m.
Matt (Solutions): I'll post exact pricing once I pull it.
Elaine (SRE): Looping Legal for the KMS blurb in the questionnaire.
Omar (AE): Thanks all — I'll paste these into Pegasus' vendor form and update after tomorrow's call. :thumbsup:
